verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents a broad public API and an official MCP server, so much of the platform can be driven programmatically. It covers campaign creation, events, webhooks, and data export, with scoped keys, OAuth, and SDKs, and it explicitly claims headless access for people and AI agents. However, no evidence asserts or demonstrates full parity with the UI. Missing for 10: an explicit API-UI parity statement or coverage matrix, API evidence for flow/automation building, segmentation, reporting, and template/editor operations, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
